answer: Each identity runs a timber yard, locking a 75 credit bond. Each epoch it delivers a violet stamped timber log to a depot in the comet window. The depot scans the serial, weighs the log, and publishes the receipt. A missed window, reused serial, or weight mismatch burns it. Fees rise: first 36, kth 36 plus 7 times k minus 1, 1000th 7029, so 1000 fake yards pay 3532500 and lock 75000. A rented-yard ring fails: a rented stamp stays bound to its owner key, so one yard cannot yield two receipts per window. An honest yard pays 36 once and recovers its bond after one clean epoch.
